Settings
DOWNLOADS & STORAGE
Simultaneous downloads
How many files download at once. Higher values may increase download speed.
Lower this if you encounter download issues. Default = 5.
5
1

Skip large files
Skip files above a set size, so a few huge files can't bloat your drive.

Enable limit

Max size (MB)

Skip huge archives
Don't unpack a .zip that would add an enormous number of files to your course folder.

Enable limit

Max files inside an archive

Sync history
How many past sync operations to keep in the history panel. Higher values use slightly more disk space.

Keep last N syncs

Default save location
The output folder every download starts from, so you don't have to set it each time. Default = your Downloads folder.

PREFERENCES
Notifications
A sound and a native notification when a download or sync finishes.

Enable notifications

CBS filters
Adds course type, semester and year filters to every course list. For CBS students.

Enable CBS filters

Time format
Show all times as 12-hour AM/PM instead of the default 24-hour clock.

Use 12-hour format

Show help text
Keeps the Help buttons and the short explanations under the main action buttons.

Show help text

PANOPTO LECTURE RECORDINGS
Panopto lecture recordings
Look for Panopto recordings in your courses and offer them as downloads.

Include Panopto recordings

Panopto transcription engine
Configure the local model, language and compute device used to transcribe Panopto recordings into Transcripts & Subtitles. These settings are shared across every download and sync - nothing is uploaded.
Ready · active model: tiny

Manage transcription configuration

TROUBLESHOOTING
Error log file
Write a download_errors.txt into the output folder, listing any failed downloads or conversion errors.

Create error log

Save debug log

App health record
A short log of app startups, shutdowns and memory use, kept automatically. If Canvas Downloader closes unexpectedly or behaves oddly, send this file with your report. It contains no personal data, access tokens, course names or file names, and is never uploaded anywhere.
